section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 6. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 390 | 700 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 368 | 700 |
